messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — since the EU egress lockdown deployment at 12:03 UTC a bunch of GPU nodes in eu-west-1 are stuck in Initializing. Kubelet shows KMS/decrypt errors.
Anil Shah: digging in. quick grep from gpu-node-37 kubelet log: 
```
 2026-03-21T12:07:45Z error decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
```
Zoe Chen: Confirmed on my end. priv-keystore-eu is returning 403 for the node role when it tries to fetch the ephemeral signing key. Looks like the new IAM condition on the egress policy is blocking the priv-keystore endpoint. @Anil can you check the role boundary changes from the rollout?
Anil Shah: Ran sts get-caller-identity from a staging node and it's AccessDenied. Searching CloudTrail shows ConditionalCheck on AssumeRole with sourceVpc != allowed list. The infra-deploy bot applied EGRESS-HARDEN-EU which added the condition.
ops-bot: deploy infra-deploy/egress-hardening-eu succeeded (id: dep-20260321-1203) by @infra-deploy.
Maya Patel: We need a fast mitigation — either open the allowlist for priv-keystore or rollback. Which is faster to restore GPU onboarding?
Zoe Chen: Adding the priv-keystore endpoint to the firewall allowlist is fastest. Rollback means extra approvals. We should also reduce audit noise to avoid cost spike while retries happen.
Anil Shah: I'll open a small allowlist rule for priv-keystore.euwest1.internal:443 from the GPU subnets and patch the policy. PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/egress/PR-4321 (small CIDR allow).
Priya Gupta: FYI cost: we're seeing a retry storm in the keystore audit pipeline — ~200GB/day extra and costs are already pinging SRE. If we keep retries for >6h, retention + egress metrics will jump our monthly run-rate. Suggest sampling the keystore audit stream to 10% until stable.
Zoe Chen: Agreed. Can we flip sampling on the audit-forwarder config? That's a single flag and doesn't require infra change.
Anil Shah: Doing it now. Patch applied to audit-forwarder in eu-west: sampling.rate=0.1.
Maya Patel: After allowlist + sampling, run the node rejoin script to recover stuck nodes. Use this snippet:
```
for i in $(kubectl get nodes -l node-pool=gpu -o name); do
  kubectl drain $i --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force || true
  sleep 5
  kubectl uncordon $i || true
done
```
Anil Shah: Ran the rejoin. 18/20 GPU nodes rejoined within 12 minutes; 2 still showing ImagePullBackOff (unrelated).
Zoe Chen: Long-term: we should (1) move priv-keystore to a private VPC endpoint that bypasses egress policy, (2) make firewall rollouts canary-first (apply to a small set of subnets), and (3) add an explicit test in infra-deploy that simulates node role assume/keystore decrypt before rolling deny rules.
Priya Gupta: Also propose an alert on audit-forwarder ingress rate + S3 put errors so cost ops get a head start next time.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Action items: 
- @Anil: keep temporary allowlist until next scheduled maintenance (ETA 48h) and make PR to convert to CIDR-limited rule.
- @Zoe: design canary policy for egress-hardening (doc + checklist).
- @Priya: add sampling and cost alert thresholds; estimate delta to present to finance.
- @Maya: follow up with oncall to verify canary run tomorrow.
ops-bot: note added to incident log: INC-20260321-EGRESS-HARDEN-EU.
Maya Patel: Thanks — looks like we're stable for now. Will monitor for another hour. :thumbsup:
